'''Sheckil'''<ref name="Force Collection" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ESB" /> Sheckil accompanied [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on his [[Escape from Cloud City|mission]] to [[Cloud City]] on [[Bespin]], and was an [[officer]] in the unit attempting to capture [[Han Solo]], [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]] and [[Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Force Collection" /> He was also in charge of escorting [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to Vader's [[Starship|ship]].<ref name="ESB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sheckil first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. He was played by [[Jeremy Bulloch]], who also played [[Boba Fett]] in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> The name "[[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]]" was first established in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] pack ''[[Cloud City Limited]]''.<ref name="CC Limited">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Sheckil}}</ref> The name was [[canon]]ized with its inclusion in the digital card game ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]''.<ref name="Force Collection" />

Originally, Bullock was not intended to play Sheckil, but ended up filling the part when the actor who was originally slated to play Sheckil was unavailable the day of shooting.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 30">{{InsiderCite|30|Head Hunter: An Interview with Jeremy Bulloch}}</ref>
